transcript.text: Bosch induction hob PUE611BB1E making a loud buzzing/humming noise when I put my big stockpot on high. Is it about to break?

I can't diagnose that problem with your hob here yet, so I won't guess at a cause or a part. Otherwise an appliance engineer can look at it, or tell me about a different problem with it.
